headline: Elizabeth Smith, Voice Coach and Juilliard Professor, Dies at 91
context: A founding faculty member of Juilliard Drama, she helped the actors Kevin Kline, Patti LuPone, Wendell Pierce and many other mentees find their voice, quite literally.
